usedFor: Gtwy runs AI agents and MSG91 sends email, so “Retry Alert is Created” can reach people through “Send a Mail”.

bestTemplate.name: “Retry Alert is Created” in Gtwy, then “Send a Mail” in MSG91
bestTemplate.why: The alert becomes a templated email, so someone hears about a retry instead of missing it.

watchOut: Mail to a person outside your team waits in Needs you for approval, so check the “Send a Mail” template.
